name: periodogram_nonpow2
comment: Sig: [P,F] = periodogram(x, win, nfft, fs) with a NON-power-of-two nfft (=N=1000). numkit's periodogram transforms via fftRadix2 (pow2-only); a non-pow2 nfft now routes through the general fft (Bluestein) instead of producing a garbage spectrum. Rectangular window (win=[]). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: 501 one-sided bins on [0,500], P(f=100)=0.5, P(f=200)=0.125, sum(P)*df=0.625=mean(x^2) (Parseval). Fixes bugs/signal/periodogram-nonpow2-nfft (was peak at ~256 Hz, sum~21.5).
